offensive.name: Chain Spark
offensive.description: Your lightning leaps from one victim to the next.
tiers: Dexterity save; arcs originate from one affected creature of your choice and cannot leap to creatures already affected this casting. The effect deals +1 die of lightning damage, and one arc leaps to a creature within 15 feet of the original target — it takes half the effect's damage on a failed save.
Bonus damage increases to +2 dice. Arcs leap to 2 creatures within 15 feet — each takes full damage on a failed save, half on a success.
Bonus damage increases to +3 dice. Arcs leap to 3 creatures within 20 feet. Creatures wearing metal armor or made of metal have disadvantage on the save.

Trigger a Chainstorm — lightning arcs to all creatures within 30 feet of the arcs' origin creature. Each must make a Dexterity save or take full damage and be Stunned until the end of their next turn.

offensive.name: Thunderbreak
offensive.description: Your lightning doesn't just shock — it shatters.
tiers: Strength save (in addition to the Composition's saving throw, if any). The effect deals +1d8 thunder damage, and targets hit must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked back 10 feet.
Bonus damage increases to +2d8. Knockback increases to 20 feet, and failed saves also impose disadvantage on Concentration checks until the end of their next turn.
Bonus damage increases to +3d8, and nearby objects or barriers within 5 feet must make a Dexterity save or shatter.
Thunderbreak becomes a concussive burst — all creatures within 20 feet of the original target must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked prone, pushed 30 feet, and Deafened for 1 minute.

offensive.name: Flash Precision
offensive.description: Lightning always hits first — it doesn't miss, it decides.
tiers: You may reroll one attack roll or saving throw associated with this effect, taking the new result.
Your lightning effects ignore cover and cannot have disadvantage imposed on their attack rolls.
Once per effect, you may automatically hit with one lightning-based attack or spell — no roll required.

Designate one creature within 120 feet — it is struck by a Sky Bolt with no attack roll, making a Dexterity save at disadvantage against your Verum DC and taking 12d12 lightning damage on a failure (half on success). On a failure it also cannot use reactions until the end of its next turn and immediately drops Concentration if applicable.

supportive.name: Voltstride
supportive.description: You move as fast as thought.
tiers: When casting the effect, you may teleport up to 10 feet as part of the same action.
Teleport range increases to 30 feet, and you gain advantage on the next Dexterity saving throw you make before the start of your next turn.
You may teleport before or after the effect resolves, and you ignore opportunity attacks during this movement.
For 1 minute, you may divide yourself into afterimages — gaining +5 AC against one attack per turn, and teleporting up to 60 feet as a reaction whenever you are targeted by an attack or spell.

control.name: Conductive Charge
control.description: You leave behind a charge that's waiting to explode.
tiers: Dexterity save. A creature that fails becomes Charged for the Composition's condition duration or until triggered. The next time it takes damage, it takes an extra 1d6 + your Verum Modifier lightning damage.
Detonation increases to 2d6 + your Verum Modifier. Charged creatures glow faintly, cannot benefit from invisibility, and have disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws.

Detonation increases to 3d6 + your Verum Modifier. The charge jumps — if the Charged creature is within 10 feet of another creature when it takes damage, that creature also takes the bonus lightning damage.
Charged targets become highly unstable — if they die while Charged, they explode, dealing 6d10 lightning damage in a 20-foot radius (Dexterity save halves).

creation.name: Stormforged
creation.description: Nothing you make from lightning ever holds still.
tiers: Your creations crackle. A creature that touches or strikes a Structure, or is hit by a Construct or an Object you made, takes 1d6 lightning damage. Constructs gain +10 feet of speed.
Your creations are immune to lightning damage. A creature hit by a Construct must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Verum DC or lose its reaction until the start of its next turn.
Structures conduct — a creature wearing metal armor that starts its turn within 5 feet of one takes 2d6 lightning damage. Constructs may teleport up to 30 feet as a bonus action.

Constructs are living storms: once per turn, their attack arcs to one creature within 15 feet of the target for half damage. A destroyed Structure or Construct discharges for 6d10 lightning damage in a 20-foot radius (Dexterity save for half).

utility.name: Quicksilver Current
utility.description: The message and the messenger are the same spark.
tiers: Send a message of up to 25 words as a spark to a creature you know within 1 mile — it arrives instantly. Power or overload a small mechanism. Sense electrical currents and gathering storms within 300 feet.
Quicken a group — you and allies within 30 feet gain +10 feet of speed and advantage on initiative for 1 hour. Read the sky to know the weather for the next 24 hours.
Ride the bolt — you and up to three willing creatures travel as lightning to any point you can see within 1 mile, arriving instantly. Disable a nonmagical mechanism or construct by touch.
Call or still a storm over a region up to 1 mile across for 1 hour, or send a single spark-message to every creature you know within 100 miles.

complementEffects.name: Overclock
complementEffects.description: The voltage doesn't just hurt — it scrambles.
complementEffects.effect: On a hit or failed save against the primary effect, the target must succeed on a Dexterity save against your Verum DC or act last in the initiative order on their next turn, regardless of their initiative roll.
upgrades: Level 5+: On a failed save, the target also cannot take reactions until the start of their next turn.
Level 11+: Creatures that fail also have disadvantage on the first attack roll or saving throw they make on their next turn.

complementEffects.name: Static Field
complementEffects.description: Your charge bleeds outward, sharpening everything around you.
complementEffects.effect: When the primary effect resolves, you generate a Static Field for 1 minute — allies within 15 feet gain +2 to initiative rolls and cannot be surprised while within range.
upgrades: Level 5+: Allies within the field also gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws while it is active.
Level 11+: The radius increases to 30 feet, and allies within it may use their reaction to move up to 10 feet when they would otherwise be hit by an attack.

complementEffects.name: Groundstrike
complementEffects.description: The bolt pins them to the earth.
complementEffects.effect: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their save, that target must succeed on a Dexterity save against your Verum DC or be unable to teleport, use movement-based abilities, or take the Dash action until the end of their next turn.
upgrades: Level 5+: On a failed save, the target also cannot take reactions and has its movement speed reduced by 15 feet until the end of their next turn.
Level 11+: Creatures that fail are additionally knocked prone, and standing up costs them their full movement rather than half.
